    Compatibility Check

    Check that every master of each glyph can interpolate: same contours, nodes, anchors, components.

    The tree lists each glyph with ✓ or ✗; expand it to see the counts per master, with the values that differ from the other masters highlighted. Contour structure is compared node by node (on-curve / handle pattern), anchors by name and components by base glyph. Select the failing glyphs in the Font window with one click. Read-only.

    Run Masters > Compatibility Check from FontLab's Scripts menu.

    Read installation and working with scripts before use.

    Source

    Python source
    # this_file: Scripts/Masters/Compatibility Check.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Masters · Compatibility Check
"""Check that every master of each glyph can interpolate: same contours, nodes, anchors, components.

The tree lists each glyph with ✓ or ✗; expand it to see the counts per master, with the values
that differ from the other masters highlighted. Contour structure is compared node by node
(on-curve / handle pattern), anchors by name and components by base glyph. Select the failing
glyphs in the Font window with one click. Read-only.
"""

from typing import Any, ClassVar

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
    masters_api,
    masters_dialog_type,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    masters_make_table as make_table,  # noqa: F401 - original helper interface
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = masters_api()
muted = _api.muted
selected_names = _api.selected_names
master_layers = _api.master_layers
own_contours = _api.own_contours
node_points = _api.node_points
signature = _api.signature
summary = _api.summary
check_glyph = _api.check_glyph
all_names = _api.all_names
TITLE = "Master Compatibility"
KEY = "masters_compatibility_check"


class SampleDialog(masters_dialog_type()):
    """Keep the original per-menu shell interface on the shared owned panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build every control before initial binding or native reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


def select_in_font_window(names: list[str]) -> None:
    """Preserve the public original selector, guarded by the active dialog snapshot."""
    import sys

    dialog = getattr(sys, "_fontlab_samples", {}).get(KEY)
    if dialog is None:
        raise ValueError("Open the compatibility panel before selecting results.")
    dialog.select_names(names)


class Compatibility(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original read-only Masters tool with guarded native actions."""

    ACTION = "Select ✗ Glyphs"
    COLUMNS: ClassVar[list[str]] = [
        "Glyph · master",
        "Contours",
        "Nodes",
        "Anchors",
        "Components",
        "Status",
    ]

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Build every original chart/table/tree control and guarded action connection."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(600)
        grid = self.form()
        self.source = QtGui.QComboBox()
        self.source.addItem(f"Selected glyphs ({len(self.names)})")
        self.source.addItem("Whole font")
        self._connect(self.source.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Glyphs"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.source, 0, 1)
        grid.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        self.tree = QtGui.QTreeWidget()
        self.tree.setColumnCount(len(self.COLUMNS))
        self.tree.setHeaderLabels(self.COLUMNS)
        self.tree.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.tree.setRootIsDecorated(True)
        self.tree.setUniformRowHeights(True)
        header = self.tree.header()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(5, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        header.setStretchLastSection(False)
        self.tree.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.tree.setMinimumHeight(300)
        self.root.addWidget(self.tree, 1)

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read and render complete results from the original bound font and selection."""
        (self.results, self.failing) = ({}, [])
        self._structures = {}
        self.tree.clear()
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            self.apply_button.setEnabled(False)
            return
        self._scope_whole = self.source.currentIndex == 1
        names = all_names() if self._scope_whole else self.names
        self._scope_names = tuple(names)
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{len(names)} glyphs across {len(self.masters)} masters: {', '.join(self.masters)}"
        )
        accent = QtGui.QColor(
            self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Active, QtGui.QPalette.Link)
        )
        bad = QtGui.QColor("#d33")
        ink = QtGui.QBrush(
            self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Active, QtGui.QPalette.WindowText)
        )
        muted_color = QtGui.QColor(
            self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Active, QtGui.QPalette.WindowText)
        )
        muted_color.setAlpha(130)
        right = int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter)
        for name in names:
            glyph = self.package.findName(name)
            if glyph is None:
                continue
            (sigs, ok, problems) = check_glyph(glyph, self.masters)
            self._structures[name] = sigs
            self.results[name] = ok
            if not ok:
                self.failing.append(name)
            top = QtGui.QTreeWidgetItem(self.tree)
            top.setText(0, name)
            top.setForeground(0, ink)
            top.setText(5, "✓" if ok else "✗ " + ", ".join(problems))
            top.setTextAlignment(5, right)
            top.setForeground(5, QtGui.QBrush(muted_color if ok else bad))
            values = {m: summary(s) for (m, s) in sigs.items() if s is not None}
            for master, sig in sigs.items():
                child = QtGui.QTreeWidgetItem(top)
                child.setText(0, master)
                for column in range(5):
                    child.setForeground(column, ink)
                if sig is None:
                    child.setText(1, "auto layer · not compared")
                    child.setForeground(1, QtGui.QBrush(muted_color))
                    continue
                for column, value in enumerate(summary(sig), start=1):
                    child.setText(column, str(value))
                    child.setTextAlignment(column, right)
                    others = [v[column - 1] for (m, v) in values.items() if m != master]
                    if others and value != max(set(others), key=others.count):
                        font = child.font(column)
                        font.setBold(True)
                        child.setFont(column, font)
                        child.setForeground(column, QtGui.QBrush(accent))
            top.setExpanded(not ok)
        self.apply_button.setEnabled(bool(self.failing))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.failing)} of {len(self.results)} glyphs incompatible"
        )

    def apply(self) -> None:
        """Refuse changed displayed source before the original explicit UI action."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        self.select_names(self.failing)
        self.last_result = {"selected": list(self.failing)}
        fontlab.UpdateAll()
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(self.failing)} incompatible glyphs in the Font window"
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show this owned original Masters tool."""
    return show_script_dialog(Compatibility, KEY)

    main()

    Glyph Weight Chart

    Bar chart of the ink area of the selected glyphs in every master.

    Ink area is the filled area of the outline: contour areas from the flattened curves, counters subtracted by nesting. Overlapping contours are counted twice, so remove overlaps first for exact numbers. Each glyph gets one bar per master in axis order, labelled in thousands of square units. Read-only.

    Run Masters > Glyph Weight Chart from FontLab's Scripts menu.

    Read installation and working with scripts before use.

    Source

    Python source
    # this_file: Scripts/Masters/Glyph Weight Chart.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Masters · Glyph Weight Chart
"""Bar chart of the ink area of the selected glyphs in every master.

Ink area is the filled area of the outline: contour areas from the flattened curves, counters
subtracted by nesting. Overlapping contours are counted twice, so remove overlaps first for exact
numbers. Each glyph gets one bar per master in axis order, labelled in thousands of square units.
Read-only.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
    masters_api,
    masters_dialog_type,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    masters_view_types,
    show_script_dialog,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    masters_fill_table as fill_table,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    masters_make_table as make_table,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = masters_api()
muted = _api.muted
selected_names = _api.selected_names
master_layers = _api.master_layers
node_points = _api.node_points
polygon = _api.polygon
inside = _api.inside
ink_area = _api.ink_area
layer_contours = _api.layer_contours
master_order = _api.master_order
nice_ticks = _api.nice_ticks
BarChart = masters_view_types().BarChart
series_colors = masters_view_types().series_colors
TITLE = "Glyph Weight Chart"
KEY = "masters_glyph_weight_chart"
STEPS = 12
MAX_GLYPHS = 10


class SampleDialog(masters_dialog_type()):
    """Keep the original per-menu shell interface on the shared owned panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build every control before initial binding or native reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


class WeightChart(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original read-only Masters tool with guarded native actions."""

    ACTION = None

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Build every original chart/table/tree control and guarded action connection."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(620)
        self.chart = BarChart()
        self.chart.report = self.paint_report
        self.root.addWidget(self.chart, 1)
        self.table = make_table(["Glyph"], 90)
        self.root.addWidget(self.table)

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read and render complete results from the original bound font and selection."""
        if not hasattr(self, "chart"):
            return
        self.areas = {}
        if not self.describe_selection():
            self.chart.groups = []
            self.chart.update()
            return
        order = master_order(self.package)
        for glyph in self.glyphs()[:MAX_GLYPHS]:
            found = master_layers(glyph, order)
            self.areas[glyph.name] = [
                ink_area(layer_contours(found[m])) if m in found else 0.0 for m in order
            ]
        self.chart.masters = order
        self.chart.groups = list(self.areas.items())
        self.chart.update()
        self.table.setColumnCount(len(order) + 1)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["Glyph"] + [f"{m} (units²)" for m in order]
        )
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents
        )
        fill_table(
            self.table,
            [
                (name, *tuple(f"{v:,.0f}" for v in row))
                for (name, row) in self.areas.items()
            ],
        )
        self.status.setText("Ink area per master · overlapping contours count twice")


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show this owned original Masters tool."""
    return show_script_dialog(WeightChart, KEY)

    Interpolation Preview

    Preview a glyph between two masters with a slider, from the masters' own nodes.

    Pick two masters and drag the slider: the painter blends every node linearly (0 % = first master, 100 % = second) and draws the result over faint outlines of both masters. Incompatible layers (different contour or node structure) are reported instead of drawn. Read-only.

    Run Masters > Interpolation Preview from FontLab's Scripts menu.

    Read installation and working with scripts before use.

    Source

    Python source
    # this_file: Scripts/Masters/Interpolation Preview.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Masters · Interpolation Preview
"""Preview a glyph between two masters with a slider, from the masters' own nodes.

Pick two masters and drag the slider: the painter blends every node linearly (0 % = first
master, 100 % = second) and draws the result over faint outlines of both masters. Incompatible
layers (different contour or node structure) are reported instead of drawn. Read-only."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - Original public helper re-export.
    interpolation_api,
    interpolation_view_type,
    review_dialog_type,
    review_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = interpolation_api()
selected_names, master_layers = _api.selected_names, _api.master_layers
node_points, outline, problem, blend = (
    _api.node_points,
    _api.outline,
    _api.problem,
    _api.blend,
)
outline_path, fit_transform = _api.outline_path, _api.fit_transform
muted = _api.muted
SampleDialog = review_dialog_type()
BlendView = interpolation_view_type()
TITLE = "Interpolation Preview"
KEY = "masters_interpolation_preview"


class Interpolation(SampleDialog):
    """Keep the original complete two-master node interpolation panel."""

    ACTION = None

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build every original control and Close before native source binding."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.build()
        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.root.addLayout(footer)
        self.initial_refresh()

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Build every original glyph/master/position control and the full preview."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(560)
        grid = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        grid.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        grid.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.root.addLayout(grid)
        self.glyph_combo = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for name in self.names:
            self.glyph_combo.addItem(name)
        self.first, self.second = (QtGui.QComboBox(), QtGui.QComboBox())
        for combo in (self.first, self.second):
            for master in self.masters:
                combo.addItem(master)
        if len(self.masters) > 1:
            self.second.setCurrentIndex(len(self.masters) - 1)
        self.slider = QtGui.QSlider(QtCore.Qt.Horizontal)
        self.slider.setRange(0, 100)
        self.slider.setValue(50)
        self.percent = QtGui.QLabel("50 %")
        self.percent.setMinimumWidth(48)
        self.percent.setAlignment(int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter))
        for combo in (self.glyph_combo, self.first, self.second):
            self._connect(combo.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.slider.valueChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Glyph"), 0, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.glyph_combo, 0, 1, 1, 3)
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Between"), 1, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.first, 1, 1)
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("and"), 1, 2)
        grid.addWidget(self.second, 1, 3)
        grid.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Position"), 2, 0)
        grid.addWidget(self.slider, 2, 1, 1, 2)
        grid.addWidget(self.percent, 2, 3)
        grid.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        grid.setColumnStretch(3, 1)
        self.view = BlendView()
        self.view.report = self.paint_report
        self.root.addWidget(self.view, 1)

    @review_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Blend complete corresponding nodes after validating the old cached source."""
        if not hasattr(self, "view"):
            return
        self.mix = []
        if not self.describe_selection():
            self.view.a = self.view.b = self.view.mix = []
            self.view.update()
            return
        glyph = self.package.findName(self.glyph_combo.currentText)
        layers = master_layers(glyph, self.masters)
        first, second = (
            layers.get(self.first.currentText),
            layers.get(self.second.currentText),
        )
        t = self.slider.value / 100.0
        self.percent.setText(f"{self.slider.value} %")
        a = outline(first) if first is not None else []
        b = outline(second) if second is not None else []
        why = problem(a, b)
        self.view.a, self.view.b = (a, b)
        if why is None:
            self.mix = blend(a, b, t)
            self.view.message = ""
            self.status.setText(
                f"{glyph.name}: {self.slider.value} % from {self.first.currentText} to {self.second.currentText} · {sum(len(c) for c in a)} nodes"
            )
        else:
            self.view.message = f"Not compatible: {why}"
            self.status.setText(
                f"{glyph.name} cannot interpolate between these masters: {why}"
            )
        self.view.mix = self.mix
        self.view.update()


def main() -> Any:
    """Show the original non-modal interpolation controls and complete painter."""
    return show_script_dialog(Interpolation, KEY)

    Master Switcher

    Choose the font's current master from a compact modeless palette.

    Run the script with a font open. Click a master button; its axis location appears below its name. The current master is checked and bold. Use the first nine button shortcuts while the palette has focus. The controls change the package master, using FontLab's native setMaster/UpdateAll behavior. Close releases owned signals. Reopen the palette after changing the font's masters or their locations.

    Run Masters > Master Switcher from FontLab's Scripts menu.

    Python source
    # this_file: Scripts/Masters/Master Switcher.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Choose the font's current master from a compact modeless palette.

Run the script with a font open. Click a master button; its axis location appears
below its name. The current master is checked and bold. Use the first nine button
shortcuts while the palette has focus. The controls change the package master,
using FontLab's native setMaster/UpdateAll behavior. Close releases owned signals.
Reopen the palette after changing the font's masters or their locations.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - Original public interface.
    master_switcher_api,
    master_switcher_dialog_type,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = master_switcher_api()
master_order, location_label, switch = (
    _api.master_order,
    _api.location_label,
    _api.switch,
)
TITLE, KEY = "Master Switcher", "masters_switcher_palette"
BUTTON_COLUMNS = 3


class SampleDialog(master_switcher_dialog_type()):
    """Keep the original shell interface on the existing guarded Masters dialog."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


class Switcher(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original master buttons, populated only after native binding."""

    ACTION = None

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Create the owned row/group before the first native source read."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(360)
        self.buttons = {}
        self.button_grid = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        self.button_grid.setHorizontalSpacing(8)
        self.button_grid.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.group = QtGui.QButtonGroup(self)
        self.group.setExclusive(True)
        self.root.addLayout(self.button_grid)

    def populate_buttons(self, values: tuple) -> None:
        """Retain original labels, sizes, shortcuts and exclusive checkable state."""
        for index, (master, where) in enumerate(values):
            if master in self.buttons:
                continue
            button = QtGui.QToolButton(self)
            button.setText(master + (f"\n{where}" if where else ""))
            button.setCheckable(True)
            button.setToolButtonStyle(QtCore.Qt.ToolButtonTextOnly)
            button.setMinimumSize(96, 52)
            button.setSizePolicy(QtGui.QSizePolicy.Expanding, QtGui.QSizePolicy.Fixed)
            if index < 9:
                button.setToolTip(
                    f"{master} (⌘{index + 1} while this palette is focused)"
                )
                button.setShortcut(QtGui.QKeySequence(f"Ctrl+{index + 1}"))
            self.group.addButton(button)
            self.buttons[master] = button
            self.button_grid.addWidget(
                button, index // BUTTON_COLUMNS, index % BUTTON_COLUMNS
            )
            self._connect(button.clicked, lambda *a, m=master: self.choose(m))

    def choose(self, master: str) -> None:
        """Check the bound source before making an explicit master current."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        switch(self.package, master)
        self.refresh()

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Publish original current-master emphasis from the bound font."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            return
        current = self.package.master
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"{len(self.masters)} masters · click to make one current"
        )
        for master, button in self.buttons.items():
            button.setChecked(master == current)
            font = button.font
            font.setBold(master == current)
            button.setFont(font)
        self.status.setText(f"Current master: {current}")


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the owned palette through the shared script registry."""
    return show_script_dialog(Switcher, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    # this_file: Scripts/Masters/Overview.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# FLM: Masters · Masters Overview
"""One table of all masters: axis location, vertical metrics and italic angle.

Rows follow the font's master order; the current master is bold. Vertical metrics come from
``fontlab.FontMetrics(package, master)``; FontLab has no per-master italic-angle accessor, so each
master is made current for the read and the original master is restored. Double-click a row to
make that master current. Read-only otherwise.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
    masters_api,
    masters_dialog_type,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    masters_fill_table as fill_table,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    masters_make_table as make_table,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = masters_api()
muted = _api.muted
selected_names = _api.selected_names
location_text = _api.location_text
italic_angles = _api.italic_angles
overview = _api.overview
TITLE = "Masters Overview"
KEY = "masters_overview"
METRICS = [
    ("Ascender", "ascender"),
    ("Cap height", "capsHeight"),
    ("x-height", "xHeight"),
    ("Descender", "descender"),
]


class SampleDialog(masters_dialog_type()):
    """Keep the original per-menu shell interface on the shared owned panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build every control before initial binding or native reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


class Overview(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original read-only Masters tool with guarded native actions."""

    ACTION = None

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Build every original chart/table/tree control and guarded action connection."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(680)
        headers = (
            ["Master", "Location"]
            + [label for (label, _) in METRICS]
            + ["Italic angle"]
        )
        self.table = make_table(headers, 200)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(
            1, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents
        )
        self.root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        self._connect(
            self.table.cellDoubleClicked, lambda row, column, *a: self.make_current(row)
        )
        hint = QtGui.QLabel(
            "Double-click a master to make it current. Values that differ between masters are highlighted."
        )
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        self.root.addWidget(hint)

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read and render complete results from the original bound font and selection."""
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            self.rows = []
            return
        self.rows = overview(self.package)
        axes = ", ".join(f"{a.name} ({a.tag})" for a in self.package.axes) or "no axes"
        self.subtitle.setText(f"{len(self.rows)} masters · {axes}")
        varies = {c for c in range(2, 7) if len({row[c] for row in self.rows}) > 1}
        cells = [
            (r[0], r[1], *tuple(f"{v:g}" for v in r[2:6]), f"{r[6]:g}°")
            for r in self.rows
        ]
        fill_table(self.table, cells, lambda r, c, text: c in varies)
        current = self.package.master
        for row, cells_row in enumerate(cells):
            if cells_row[0] == current:
                item = self.table.item(row, 0)
                font = item.font()
                font.setBold(True)
                item.setFont(font)
                item.setText(cells_row[0] + "  (current)")
        self.status.setText(f"Current master: {current}")

    def make_current(self, row: Any) -> None:
        """Refuse changed displayed source before the original explicit UI action."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        master = self.rows[row][0]
        self.package.setMaster(master, True)
        fontlab.UpdateAll()
        self.refresh()


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show this owned original Masters tool."""
    return show_script_dialog(Overview, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Line chart of the advance widths of the selected glyphs across masters.

Masters run left to right in axis order; each glyph is one line with its widths labelled, so a
master that breaks the progression stands out at once. Read-only.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package,  # noqa: F401 - original public interface
    masters_api,
    masters_dialog_type,
    masters_snapshot_refresh,
    masters_view_types,
    show_script_dialog,
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    masters_make_table as make_table,  # noqa: F401 - original helper interface
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = masters_api()
muted = _api.muted
selected_names = _api.selected_names
master_layers = _api.master_layers
widths = _api.widths
master_order = _api.master_order
nice_ticks = _api.nice_ticks
label_tops = _api.label_tops
spread = _api.spread
LineChart = masters_view_types().LineChart
series_colors = masters_view_types().series_colors
TITLE = "Width Chart"
KEY = "masters_width_chart"
MAX_SERIES = 12


class SampleDialog(masters_dialog_type()):
    """Keep the original per-menu shell interface on the shared owned panel."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build every control before initial binding or native reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


class WidthChart(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original read-only Masters tool with guarded native actions."""

    ACTION = None

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Build every original chart/table/tree control and guarded action connection."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(620)
        self.chart = LineChart()
        self.chart.report = self.paint_report
        self.root.addWidget(self.chart, 1)

    @masters_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read and render complete results from the original bound font and selection."""
        if not hasattr(self, "chart"):
            return
        self.data = {}
        if not self.describe_selection():
            self.chart.series = []
            self.chart.update()
            return
        order = master_order(self.package)
        for glyph in self.glyphs()[:MAX_SERIES]:
            self.data[glyph.name] = widths(glyph, order)
        self.chart.masters = order
        self.chart.series = [
            (name, [w for (_, w) in row]) for (name, row) in self.data.items()
        ]
        self.chart.update()
        extra = len(self.glyphs()) - MAX_SERIES
        note = f" · first {MAX_SERIES} glyphs shown" if extra > 0 else ""
        self.status.setText(f"Advance widths across {len(order)} masters{note}")


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show this owned original Masters tool."""
    return show_script_dialog(WidthChart, KEY)

    Check Tabular Widths

    Check exact selected-layer advances against the first selected occurrence.

    Select glyphs in a Font window or layer occurrences in a Glyph window. Run this Metrics command. The first occurrence supplies the reference. Editor repeats retain their own layer choices; Font-window rows use the current master. Fractional values remain exact. Metrics keys and Auto do not override the actual advances. # FLM: Metrics · Spacing String Preview
"""Render a spacing control string such as HOHnono from the font's own outlines and advances.

Type characters or /glyphname tokens, pick a master, and judge the rhythm of straight and round
sidebearings without generating a font. Advance boxes and LSB/RSB numbers can be shown under
each glyph. Nothing is edited; the preview follows the outlines as they are now."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package as current_package,  # noqa: PLC0414 - original public helper
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    inspectors_api,
    inspectors_dialog_type,
    inspectors_snapshot_refresh,
    inspectors_view_types,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = inspectors_api()
muted = _api.muted
parse_text = _api.parse_text
outline = _api.outline
layout = _api.layout
Canvas = inspectors_view_types().Canvas
TITLE = "Spacing String Preview"
KEY = "metrics_spacing_string_preview"
DEFAULT_TEXT = "HHOHOOH nnonoon"
MARGIN = 24


class SampleDialog(inspectors_dialog_type()):
    """Original menu shell on the existing owned Proof/Names/Masters lifecycle."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Finish controls/status/Close before fallible font reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


class SpacingPreview(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original inspector with complete snapshots and owned cleanup."""

    ACTION = None

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Retain every original control/default before reading native data."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(640)
        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.text = QtGui.QLineEdit(DEFAULT_TEXT)
        self.text.setPlaceholderText("Characters, or /glyphname tokens")
        self.master = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for name in self.masters:
            self.master.addItem(name)
        if self.current_master in self.masters:
            self.master.setCurrentIndex(self.masters.index(self.current_master))
        self.show_boxes = QtGui.QCheckBox("Advance boxes")
        self.show_boxes.setChecked(True)
        self.show_numbers = QtGui.QCheckBox("LSB / RSB numbers")
        self.show_numbers.setChecked(True)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Text"), 0, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.text, 0, 1, 1, 3)
        form.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Master"), 1, 0)
        form.addWidget(self.master, 1, 1)
        form.addWidget(self.show_boxes, 1, 2)
        form.addWidget(self.show_numbers, 1, 3)
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        self.root.addLayout(form)

        self.canvas = Canvas(self)
        self.root.addWidget(self.canvas, 1)

        self._connect(self.text.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.master.currentIndexChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.show_boxes.toggled, lambda *a: self.canvas.update())
        self._connect(self.show_numbers.toggled, lambda *a: self.canvas.update())

    def chosen_master(self) -> Any:
        """Return the original selector master without changing the font master."""
        return self.masters[self.master.currentIndex] if self.masters else ""

    def path(self, name: Any) -> Any:
        """Return only a path captured by the completed refresh."""
        return self.paths[(name, self.chosen_master())]

    def empty_message(self) -> str:
        """Keep the original no-font and empty-text canvas messages."""
        if self.package is None:
            return "Open a font first."
        return "Type characters or /glyphname tokens above."

    @inspectors_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read a complete original report under the shared font/master snapshot guard."""
        self.sync_controls()
        self.ascender = self.package.ascender_value if self.package else 800
        self.descender = self.package.descender_value if self.package else -200
        self.paths, self._outline_sources = {}, {}
        if self.package is None:
            self.rows = []
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        else:
            names = parse_text(self.text.text, self.package)
            self.rows = layout(self.package, names, self.chosen_master())
            self.paths = {
                (name, self.chosen_master()): outline(
                    self.package.findName(name).findLayer(self.chosen_master())
                )
                for name, *_ in self.rows
            }
            self._outline_sources = {
                (name, self.chosen_master()): _api.outline_source(
                    self.package.findName(name).findLayer(self.chosen_master())
                )
                for name, *_ in self.rows
            }
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{self.chosen_master()} master · {len(names)} glyphs drawn from their outlines and advances, no kerning",
            )
        width = self.rows[-1][1] + self.rows[-1][2] if self.rows else 0
        self.status.setText(f"{len(self.rows)} glyphs · line width {width:g} units")
        self.canvas.update()


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete original owned inspector."""
    return show_script_dialog(SpacingPreview, KEY)

# FLM: Metrics · Width Table
"""Advance widths of the selected glyphs across all masters, sortable, with odd progressions flagged.

In a weight family the widths usually grow (or shrink) steadily from master to master. A glyph
whose width goes up and then down again is flagged: often a spacing slip. Click a column header
to sort; "Select flagged" selects those glyphs in the Font window. Nothing is edited."""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    current_package as current_package,  # noqa: PLC0414 - original public helper
)
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    inspectors_api,
    inspectors_dialog_type,
    inspectors_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui
fontlab = ap.fontlab
_api = inspectors_api()
muted = _api.muted
selected_glyphs = _api.selected_glyphs
widths = _api.widths
progression = _api.progression
report = _api.report
TITLE = "Width Table"
KEY = "metrics_width_table"


class SampleDialog(inspectors_dialog_type()):
    """Original menu shell on the existing owned Proof/Names/Masters lifecycle."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Finish controls/status/Close before fallible font reads."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)


def select_in_font(names: list[str]) -> None:
    """Select through the active panel's complete source and identity preflight."""
    import sys

    dialog = getattr(sys, "_fontlab_samples", {}).get(KEY)
    if dialog is None:
        raise ValueError("Open this panel before selecting its results.")
    dialog.select_names(names)


class WidthTable(SampleDialog):
    """Complete original inspector with complete snapshots and owned cleanup."""

    ACTION = "Select flagged"

    def build(self) -> None:
        """Retain every original control/default before reading native data."""
        self.setMinimumWidth(560)
        options = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.only_flagged = QtGui.QCheckBox("Show only mixed progressions")
        options.addWidget(self.only_flagged)
        options.addStretch(1)
        self.root.addLayout(options)

        headers = ["Glyph", *self.masters, "Progression"]
        self.table = QtGui.QTableWidget(0, len(headers))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(headers)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.table.setMinimumHeight(240)
        self.root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        self._connect(self.only_flagged.toggled, lambda *a: self.fill())

    def flagged(self) -> Any:
        """Return mixed progressions in captured glyph order."""
        return [name for name, _, trend in self.rows if trend == "mixed"]

    @inspectors_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read a complete original report under the shared font/master snapshot guard."""
        self.glyphs = (
            [self.package.findName(name) for name in self.names] if self.package else []
        )
        if any(g is None or g.isNull for g in self.glyphs):
            raise ValueError("Selected glyph source changed; reopen this tool.")
        self.table.setColumnCount(len(self.masters) + 2)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Glyph", *self.masters, "Progression"])
        count = len(self.glyphs)
        if self.package is None:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif not count:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select glyphs in the Font window, then run this script again.",
            )
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{count} glyph{'s' if count != 1 else ''} × {len(self.masters)} masters, "
                f"masters in font order: {' → '.join(self.masters)}",
            )
        self.rows = report(self.glyphs, self.masters)
        self.fill()

    def fill(self) -> None:
        """Render all original numeric cells, warning labels and exact mixed filter."""
        if self._snapshot_valid:
            self.ensure_snapshot()
        warn = QtGui.QColor("#d33")
        shown = [
            r for r in self.rows if not self.only_flagged.isChecked() or r[2] == "mixed"
        ]
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(False)
        self.table.setRowCount(len(shown))
        for row, (name, values, trend) in enumerate(shown):
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(name))
            for column, value in enumerate(values, 1):
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem("–")
                if value is not None:
                    item.setData(
                        QtCore.Qt.DisplayRole,
                        value,
                    )  # an int sorts numerically
                item.setTextAlignment(
                    int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignVCenter),
                )
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
            flag = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem("⚠ mixed" if trend == "mixed" else trend)
            flag.setTextAlignment(int(QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter))
            if trend == "mixed":
                bold = flag.font()
                bold.setBold(True)
                flag.setFont(bold)
                flag.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(warn))
            self.table.setItem(row, len(values) + 1, flag)
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(True)
        flagged = self.flagged()
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(flagged)} of {len(self.rows)} glyphs with a mixed progression",
        )
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(flagged))

    def table_values(self) -> Any:
        """{glyph: [widths]} as shown (used by tests and handy for copying)."""
        out = {}
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount):
            name = self.table.item(row, 0).text()
            out[name] = [
                self.table.item(row, c).data(QtCore.Qt.DisplayRole)
                for c in range(1, len(self.masters) + 1)
            ]
        return out

    def select_flagged(self) -> None:
        """Preflight displayed widths before selecting exactly the mixed glyphs."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        flagged = self.flagged()
        self.select_names(flagged)
        fontlab.UpdateAll()
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(flagged)} glyph{'s' if len(flagged) != 1 else ''} in the Font window",
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Replace and show the complete original owned inspector."""
    return show_script_dialog(WidthTable, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    Case Pairs

    Find the upper- or lowercase counterparts of the selected glyphs and select them.

    Counterparts come from Unicode case mapping of each glyph's code point; unencoded alternates use their base name (a.ss01 -> A.ss01). Select the counterparts alone or together with the originals. Nothing in the font changes.

    Run Names > Case Pairs from FontLab's Scripts menu.

    Read installation and working with scripts before use.

    Source

    Python source
    # this_file: Scripts/Names/Case Pairs.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Adapted from Apache-2.0 FontLab samples; provenance in migration.json.
# FLM: Names · Case Pairs
"""Find the upper- or lowercase counterparts of the selected glyphs and select them.

Counterparts come from Unicode case mapping of each glyph's code point;
unencoded alternates use their base name (a.ss01 -> A.ss01). Select the
counterparts alone or together with the originals. Nothing in the font
changes.
"""

from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_dialog_type,
    names_font_glyphs,
    names_muted,
    names_selected_names,
    names_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Case Pairs"
KEY = "names_case_pairs"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access
def selected_names() -> list[str]:
    """Read current font state through the shared Names access helper."""
    return names_selected_names()


def font_glyphs() -> list[tuple[str, list[int]]]:
    """Read current font state through the shared Names access helper."""
    return names_font_glyphs()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def swap_case(char: str) -> str:
    """The single-character case counterpart, or "" (ß -> SS has no single counterpart)."""
    other = char.lower() if char != char.lower() else char.upper()
    return other if len(other) == 1 and other != char else ""


def index(
    glyphs: list[tuple[str, list[int]]],
) -> tuple[dict[str, list[int]], dict[int, str]]:
    """(codes by name, first glyph by code) for fast lookups."""
    by_code = {}
    for glyph, codes in glyphs:
        for code in codes:
            by_code.setdefault(code, glyph)
    return dict(glyphs), by_code


def counterpart(
    name: str, codes_of: dict[str, list[int]], by_code: dict[int, str]
) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
    """(counterpart name or None, how) for one glyph name."""
    codes = codes_of.get(name, [])
    if codes:
        other = swap_case(chr(codes[0]))
        if other and ord(other) in by_code:
            return by_code[ord(other)], f"{chr(codes[0])} → {other}"
        return (
            None,
            f"{chr(codes[0])} has no counterpart in the font" if other else "no case",
        )
    base, dot, suffix = name.partition(".")
    base_codes = codes_of.get(base, [])
    if dot and base_codes:
        partner, _ = counterpart(base, codes_of, by_code)
        if partner and f"{partner}.{suffix}" in codes_of:
            return f"{partner}.{suffix}", f"via {base} → {partner}"
    return None, "unencoded"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
muted = names_muted


class CasePairs(names_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build original controls; refresh once and retain only owned resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(480)
        self.resize(500, 440)
        self.pairs = []
        root = self.root

        self.table = self.make_table(["Glyph", "Counterpart", "How"])
        self.table.setFocusPolicy(QtCore.Qt.NoFocus)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoSelection)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        self.keep = QtGui.QCheckBox("Keep the original glyphs selected too")
        root.addWidget(self.keep)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.reload_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Reload selection")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select counterparts")
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.reload_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(self.reload_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.reload())
        self._connect(self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_counterparts())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.reload()

    @names_snapshot_refresh
    def reload(self) -> None:
        """Rescan the current font; render complete rows before enabling selection."""
        glyphs = font_glyphs()
        self.selection = selected_names() if glyphs else []
        codes_of, by_code = index(glyphs)
        self.pairs = [
            (name, *counterpart(name, codes_of, by_code)) for name in self.selection
        ]
        found = [p for p in self.pairs if p[1]]
        if not glyphs:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
        elif not self.selection:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Select glyphs in the Font window, then click Reload selection.",
            )
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"{len(found)} of {len(self.selection)} selected glyphs have a case counterpart "
                "in this font.",
            )
        accent = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.pairs))
        for row, (name, partner, how) in enumerate(self.pairs):
            for column, text in enumerate((name, partner or "–", how)):
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(text)
                if column == 1 and partner:
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(accent))
                if column == 2:
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(QtGui.QColor(muted(self))))
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(found))
        self.status.setText(f"{len(found)} counterpart{'s' if len(found) != 1 else ''}")

    def select_counterparts(self) -> None:
        """Select mapped partners; optionally retain the originally scanned glyphs."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        names = [p[1] for p in self.pairs if p[1]]
        if self.keep.isChecked():
            names += self.selection
        selected = self.select_names(names)
        self.last_result = {"selected": selected}
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {len(selected)} glyph{'s' if len(selected) != 1 else ''}",
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Open or replace this owned modeless Names panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(CasePairs, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    Character Info

    A live panel describing the character of the glyph selected in the Font window.

    Shows the outline next to the system font's rendering, the code point, the Unicode name and category (Python's unicodedata), case counterpart, decomposition and the UTF-8/UTF-16 encodings. It follows the selection twice a second; nothing in the font changes.

    Run Names > Character Info from FontLab's Scripts menu.

    Read installation and working with scripts before use.

    Source

    Python source
    # this_file: Scripts/Names/Character Info.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Adapted from Apache-2.0 FontLab samples; provenance in migration.json.
# FLM: Names · Character Info
"""A live panel describing the character of the glyph selected in the Font window.

Shows the outline next to the system font's rendering, the code point, the
Unicode name and category (Python's unicodedata), case counterpart,
decomposition and the UTF-8/UTF-16 encodings. It follows the selection
twice a second; nothing in the font changes.
"""

import unicodedata
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_dialog_type,
    names_muted,
    names_selected_names,
    names_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Character Info"
KEY = "names_character_info"
POLL_MS = 500
CATEGORIES = {
    "Lu": "Letter, uppercase",
    "Ll": "Letter, lowercase",
    "Lt": "Letter, titlecase",
    "Lm": "Letter, modifier",
    "Lo": "Letter, other",
    "Mn": "Mark, nonspacing",
    "Mc": "Mark, spacing",
    "Me": "Mark, enclosing",
    "Nd": "Number, decimal",
    "Nl": "Number, letter",
    "No": "Number, other",
    "Pc": "Punctuation, connector",
    "Pd": "Punctuation, dash",
    "Ps": "Punctuation, open",
    "Pe": "Punctuation, close",
    "Pi": "Punctuation, initial",
    "Pf": "Punctuation, final",
    "Po": "Punctuation, other",
    "Sm": "Symbol, math",
    "Sc": "Symbol, currency",
    "Sk": "Symbol, modifier",
    "So": "Symbol, other",
    "Zs": "Separator, space",
    "Cc": "Control",
    "Cf": "Format",
    "Co": "Private use",
    "Cn": "Unassigned",
}
FIELDS = [
    "Glyph",
    "Code point",
    "Unicode name",
    "Category",
    "Case pair",
    "Decomposition",
    "UTF-8",
    "UTF-16",
    "Escape",
]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access
def current_package() -> Any | None:
    """Read current native font state without changing font data."""
    package = fontlab.flWorkspace.instance().currentPackage
    if package is None or package.isNull:
        return None
    return package


def focused_name() -> str | None:
    """Read current font state through the shared Names access helper."""
    return next(iter(names_selected_names()), None)


def layer_path(layer: Any) -> Any:
    """The layer's outline as one QPainterPath in font units (y up), components placed."""
    path = QtGui.QPainterPath()
    path.setFillRule(QtCore.Qt.WindingFill)
    for shape in layer.shapes:
        for part in (shape.closedPath, shape.openedPath):
            if part is not None and not part.isEmpty():
                path.addPath(shape.transform.map(part))
    return path


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def describe(code: int) -> dict[str, str]:
    """{field: text} for one code point (pure Python, no font access)."""
    char = chr(code)
    category = unicodedata.category(char)
    upper, lower = char.upper(), char.lower()
    pair = lower if char != lower else upper if char != upper else ""
    utf16 = char.encode("utf-16-be")
    return {
        "Code point": f"U+{code:04X}",
        "Unicode name": unicodedata.name(char, "(no name)"),
        "Category": f"{category} · {CATEGORIES.get(category, '')}",
        "Case pair": " ".join(f"{c} U+{ord(c):04X}" for c in pair) if pair else "–",
        "Decomposition": unicodedata.decomposition(char) or "–",
        "UTF-8": " ".join(f"{b:02X}" for b in char.encode("utf-8")),
        "UTF-16": " ".join(
            utf16[i : i + 2].hex().upper() for i in range(0, len(utf16), 2)
        ),
        "Escape": f"\\u{code:04x}" if code <= 0xFFFF else f"\\U{code:08x}",
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
muted = names_muted


class Specimen(QtGui.QWidget):
    """Custom painter: the glyph outline (left) and the system font's character (right)."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build original controls; refresh once and retain only owned resources."""
        QtGui.QWidget.__init__(self, parent)
        self.paint_error = ""
        self.on_error = None  # dialog hook: show drawing errors in the status label
        self.setMinimumHeight(150)
        self.path, self.advance, self.char = None, 0, ""
        self.frame = (-250, 750)

    def set_content(
        self, path: Any, advance: float, char: str, frame: tuple[float, float]
    ) -> None:
        """Replace proof outline, advance, character and vertical frame."""
        self.path, self.advance, self.char, self.frame = path, advance, char, frame
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event: Any) -> None:
        """Draw the proof; contain native painter errors and always end painting."""
        painter = QtGui.QPainter(self)
        try:
            self.draw(painter)
            self.paint_error = ""
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - contain native painter failures
            self.paint_error = repr(error)
            if self.on_error is not None:
                try:
                    self.on_error(self.paint_error)
                except Exception as hook_error:  # noqa: BLE001 - contain error hook
                    self.paint_error += f"; error hook: {hook_error!r}"
        finally:
            painter.end()

    def draw(self, painter: Any) -> None:
        """Fit the full outline and metric frame inside the padded left proof.

        Include overhangs and tall accents in both-axis fitting; retain the
        baseline, labels and independent system-font proof on the right.
        """
        painter.setRenderHint(QtGui.QPainter.Antialiasing)
        text = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Text))
        faint = QtGui.QColor(text)
        faint.setAlpha(35)
        soft = QtGui.QColor(text)
        soft.setAlpha(120)
        half = self.width / 2.0
        height = self.height
        painter.setPen(QtGui.QPen(QtGui.QBrush(faint), 1.0))
        painter.drawRoundedRect(QtCore.QRectF(0.5, 0.5, half - 6, height - 1), 8, 8)
        painter.drawRoundedRect(
            QtCore.QRectF(half + 6, 0.5, half - 6.5, height - 1),
            8,
            8,
        )
        small = QtGui.QFont(painter.font())
        small.setPointSizeF(max(8.0, small.pointSizeF() * 0.85))
        painter.setFont(small)
        painter.setPen(soft)
        painter.drawText(
            QtCore.QRectF(8, height - 22, half - 20, 18),
            int(QtCore.Qt.AlignLeft),
            "Font outline",
        )
        painter.drawText(
            QtCore.QRectF(half + 14, height - 22, half - 20, 18),
            int(QtCore.Qt.AlignLeft),
            "System font",
        )
        descender, ascender = self.frame
        if self.path is not None:
            bounds = self.path.boundingRect()
            left = min(0.0, self.advance, bounds.left())
            right = max(0.0, self.advance, bounds.right())
            bottom = min(0.0, descender, bounds.top())
            top = max(0.0, ascender, bounds.bottom())
            proof_width, proof_height = half - 22, height - 38
            scale = min(
                proof_width / max(1.0, right - left),
                proof_height / max(1.0, top - bottom),
            )
            origin = 8 + (proof_width - (right - left) * scale) / 2 - left * scale
            baseline = 8 + (proof_height - (top - bottom) * scale) / 2 + top * scale
            painter.setPen(QtGui.QPen(QtGui.QBrush(faint), 1.0))
            painter.drawLine(
                QtCore.QPointF(8, baseline),
                QtCore.QPointF(half - 14, baseline),
            )
            painter.save()
            painter.translate(origin, baseline)
            painter.scale(scale, 0 - scale)
            painter.fillPath(self.path, QtGui.QBrush(text))
            painter.restore()
        if self.char:
            big = QtGui.QFont(painter.font())
            big.setPixelSize(int(height * 0.55))
            painter.setFont(big)
            painter.setPen(text)
            painter.drawText(
                QtCore.QRectF(half + 6, 0, half - 6, height - 18),
                int(QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter),
                self.char,
            )


class CharacterInfo(names_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build original controls; refresh once and retain only owned resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(480)
        self.shown_name = None
        root = self.root

        self.specimen = Specimen()
        root.addWidget(self.specimen)

        form = QtGui.QGridLayout()
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(14)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(6)
        self.fields = {}
        for row, label in enumerate(FIELDS):
            caption = QtGui.QLabel(label)
            caption.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
            value = QtGui.QLabel("–")
            value.setTextInteractionFlags(QtCore.Qt.TextSelectableByMouse)
            value.setWordWrap(True)
            caption.setAlignment(int(QtCore.Qt.AlignRight | QtCore.Qt.AlignTop))
            form.addWidget(caption, row, 0)
            form.addWidget(value, row, 1)
            self.fields[label] = value
        form.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
        root.addLayout(form)
        self.others = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.others.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        root.addWidget(self.others)
        root.addStretch(1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.specimen.on_error = lambda text: self.status.setText(
            "Drawing failed: " + text,
        )
        self.copy_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Copy character")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        footer.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self.timer = QtCore.QTimer(self)
        self.timer.setInterval(POLL_MS)
        self._connect(self.timer.timeout, lambda *a: self.poll())
        self._connect(self.copy_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.copy())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()
        self.timer.start()

    def poll(self) -> None:
        """Refresh at each timer tick, including font and master switches."""
        self.refresh()

    @names_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self, name: str | None = None) -> None:
        """Read current font data; update original fields and action availability."""
        package = current_package()
        name = name or (focused_name() if package else None)
        self.shown_name = name
        glyph = package.findName(name) if package and name else None
        self.current = {}
        if glyph is None:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                "Open a font and select a glyph in the Font window."
                if package is None
                else "Select a glyph in the Font window.",
            )
            for value in self.fields.values():
                value.setText("–")
            self.specimen.set_content(None, 0, "", (-250, 750))
            self.copy_button.setEnabled(False)
            return
        codes = list(glyph.fgGlyph.unicodes)
        layer = glyph.findLayer(package.master)
        path = layer_path(layer) if layer is not None else None
        char = chr(codes[0]) if codes else ""
        frame = (package.descender_value, package.ascender_value)
        self.specimen.set_content(
            path,
            layer.advanceWidth if layer is not None else 0,
            char,
            frame,
        )
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"Follows the Font window selection · master {package.master}",
        )
        self.current = describe(codes[0]) if codes else {}
        self.current["Glyph"] = name
        for label, value in self.fields.items():
            value.setText(
                self.current.get(
                    label,
                    "– (unencoded)" if label == "Code point" else "–",
                ),
            )
        self.others.setText(
            "Also encoded: " + ", ".join(f"U+{c:04X}" for c in codes[1:])
            if len(codes) > 1
            else "",
        )
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(bool(char))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{name} · {len(codes)} code point{'s' if len(codes) != 1 else ''}",
        )

    def copy(self) -> None:
        """Copy the current encoded character from a valid live snapshot."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        if self.specimen.char:
            QtGui.QApplication.clipboard().setText(self.specimen.char)
            self.status.setText(f"Copied {self.specimen.char}")


def main() -> Any:
    """Open or replace this owned modeless Names panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(CharacterInfo, KEY)

    Paste a text or a character set and compare it with the font's encoded characters.

    Lists characters of the text the font lacks and characters the font has that the text does not use, with names from unicodedata. Language presets fill in common alphabets. Copy the missing set, or select the extra glyphs in the Font window. Nothing in the font changes.

# FLM: Names · Charset Compare
"""Paste a text or a character set and compare it with the font's encoded characters.

Lists characters of the text the font lacks and characters the font has
that the text does not use, with names from unicodedata. Language presets
fill in common alphabets. Copy the missing set, or select the extra glyphs
in the Font window. Nothing in the font changes.
"""

import unicodedata
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_dialog_type,
    names_muted,
    names_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Charset Compare"
KEY = "names_charset_compare"
LATIN = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
PRESETS = [
    ("Paste your own text…", ""),
    ("Basic Latin (ASCII)", "".join(chr(c) for c in range(0x21, 0x7F))),
    (
        "Latin-1 letters",
        LATIN + "".join(chr(c) for c in range(0xC0, 0x100) if chr(c).isalpha()),
    ),
    ("Polish", LATIN + "ĄĆĘŁŃÓŚŹŻąćęłńóśźż"),
    ("Czech", LATIN + "ÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽáčďéěíňóřšťúůýž"),
    ("German", LATIN + "ÄÖÜẞäöüß„“‚‘"),
    ("French", LATIN + "ÀÂÆÇÉÈÊËÎÏÔŒÙÛÜŸàâæçéèêëîïôœùûüÿ«»"),
    ("Spanish", LATIN + "ÁÉÍÑÓÚÜáéíñóúü¡¿"),
    ("Turkish", LATIN + "ÇĞİÖŞÜçğıöşü"),
]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access
def font_chars() -> dict[str, str]:
    """{character: glyph name} for every encoded glyph of the current font."""
    font = fontlab.CurrentFont()
    out = {}
    for glyph in font.glyphs if font is not None else []:
        for code in glyph.unicodes:
            out.setdefault(chr(code), glyph.name)
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def text_chars(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Distinct non-whitespace characters of the text, sorted by code point."""
    return sorted({c for c in text if not c.isspace()}, key=ord)


def compare(text: str, available: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """(missing, extra): characters of the text absent from the font, and font characters absent from it."""
    wanted = text_chars(text)
    wanted_set = set(wanted)
    missing = [c for c in wanted if c not in available]
    extra = sorted(
        (c for c in available if c not in wanted_set and not c.isspace()),
        key=ord,
    )
    return missing, extra


def describe(char: str) -> str:
    """Format a character, code point and Unicode name for comparison lists."""
    return f"{char}   U+{ord(char):04X}   {unicodedata.name(char, '').title()}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
muted = names_muted


class CharsetCompare(names_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build original controls; refresh once and retain only owned resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(620)
        self.resize(680, 560)
        self.available = font_chars()
        self.missing, self.extra = [], []
        root = self.root

        row = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        row.addWidget(QtGui.QLabel("Preset"))
        self.preset = QtGui.QComboBox()
        for label, _ in PRESETS:
            self.preset.addItem(label)
        row.addWidget(self.preset, 1)
        root.addLayout(row)
        self.text = QtGui.QPlainTextEdit()
        self.text.setPlaceholderText("Paste a text or a list of characters…")
        self.text.setMaximumHeight(90)
        root.addWidget(self.text)

        lists = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        lists.setSpacing(12)
        self.missing_label, self.missing_list = self._column(lists)
        self.extra_label, self.extra_list = self._column(lists)
        root.addLayout(lists, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.copy_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Copy missing")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select extra glyphs")
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        footer.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(
            self.preset.currentIndexChanged,
            lambda *a: self.use_preset(self.preset.currentIndex),
        )
        self._connect(self.text.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.copy_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.copy_missing())
        self._connect(self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_extra())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()

    def _column(self, parent: Any) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
        """Create a read-only character list with its count heading."""
        column = QtGui.QVBoxLayout()
        label = QtGui.QLabel()
        bold = label.font
        bold.setBold(True)
        label.setFont(bold)
        listing = QtGui.QListWidget()
        listing.setSelectionMode(QtGui.QAbstractItemView.NoSelection)
        listing.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        listing.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(QtCore.Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        listing.setTextElideMode(QtCore.Qt.ElideRight)
        column.addWidget(label)
        column.addWidget(listing, 1)
        parent.addLayout(column, 1)
        return label, listing

    def use_preset(self, index: int) -> None:
        """Fill the text control with the complete selected language alphabet."""
        if 0 < index < len(PRESETS):
            self.text.setPlainText(PRESETS[index][1])

    @names_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read current font data; update original fields and action availability."""
        self.available = font_chars()
        text = self.text.toPlainText()
        self.missing, self.extra = compare(text, self.available)
        count = len(text_chars(text))
        if not self.available:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font with encoded glyphs first.")
        else:
            self.subtitle.setText(
                f"The font encodes {len(self.available)} characters; the text uses {count}.",
            )
        self.missing_label.setText(f"Missing from the font ({len(self.missing)})")
        self.extra_label.setText(f"In the font, not in the text ({len(self.extra)})")
        alert = QtGui.QColor("#d33")
        self.missing_list.clear()
        for char in self.missing:
            item = QtGui.QListWidgetItem(describe(char))
            item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(alert))
            self.missing_list.addItem(item)
        self.extra_list.clear()
        for char in self.extra:
            self.extra_list.addItem(
                QtGui.QListWidgetItem(f"{describe(char)}   · {self.available[char]}"),
            )
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(bool(self.missing))
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(self.extra) and bool(text.strip()))
        covered = count - len(self.missing)
        self.status.setText(
            f"Coverage {covered}/{count}"
            + (f" · {100.0 * covered / count:.0f}%" if count else ""),
        )

    def copy_missing(self) -> None:
        """Copy the missing character set from a valid comparison snapshot."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        QtGui.QApplication.clipboard().setText("".join(self.missing))
        self.status.setText(f"Copied {len(self.missing)} characters")

    def select_extra(self) -> None:
        """Select encoded characters absent from the text in the scanned font."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        names = [self.available[c] for c in self.extra]
        count = len(self.select_names(names))
        self.last_result = {"selected": names}
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {count} extra glyph{'s' if count != 1 else ''} in the Font window",
        )


def main() -> Any:
    """Open or replace this owned modeless Names panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(CharsetCompare, KEY)

    main()

    Glyph Finder

    Type to find glyphs by name, character or code point; Enter selects them in the Font window.

    Accepts a name fragment (acute), a wildcard pattern (*.ss0?), a character (é), or a code point (U+00E9, 0x1E82, uni00E9). The list updates as you type; double-click a row to select just that glyph. Nothing in the font changes.

    Run Names > Glyph Finder from FontLab's Scripts menu.

    Read installation and working with scripts before use.

    Source

    Python source
    # this_file: Scripts/Names/Glyph Finder.py
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Adapted from Apache-2.0 FontLab samples; provenance in migration.json.
# FLM: Names · Glyph Finder
"""Type to find glyphs by name, character or code point; Enter selects them in the Font window.

Accepts a name fragment (acute), a wildcard pattern (*.ss0?), a character
(é), or a code point (U+00E9, 0x1E82, uni00E9). The list updates as you
type; double-click a row to select just that glyph. Nothing in the font
changes.
"""

import fnmatch
import re
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

from fly import ap, qt
from fly.ap.scripting import (
    names_dialog_type,
    names_font_glyphs,
    names_muted,
    names_snapshot_refresh,
    show_script_dialog,
)

fontlab = ap.fontlab
QtCore, QtGui = qt.QtCore, qt.QtGui

TITLE = "Glyph Finder"
KEY = "names_glyph_finder"
MAX_ROWS = 3000
CODE = re.compile(r"^(?:U\+|u\+|0x|0X|uni|u)([0-9A-Fa-f]{4,6})$")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- font access
def font_glyphs() -> list[tuple[str, list[int]]]:
    """Read current font state through the shared Names access helper."""
    return names_font_glyphs()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- core
def matcher(query: str) -> tuple[str, Callable[[str, list[int]], bool]]:
    """(kind, test(name, codes) -> bool) for a query string."""
    query = query.strip()
    code = CODE.match(query)
    if code:
        value = int(code.group(1), 16)
        return "code point", lambda name, codes: value in codes
    if (len(query) == 1 and not query.isalnum()) or (
        len(query) == 1 and ord(query) > 127
    ):
        value = ord(query)
        return "character", lambda name, codes: value in codes
    if any(c in query for c in "*?["):
        return "pattern", lambda name, codes: fnmatch.fnmatchcase(name, query)
    lowered = query.lower()
    if len(query) == 1:
        value = ord(query)
        return (
            "name or character",
            lambda name, codes: value in codes or lowered in name.lower(),
        )
    return "name", lambda name, codes: lowered in name.lower()


def find(
    glyphs: list[tuple[str, list[int]]], query: str
) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, list[int]]]]:
    """(kind, [(name, codes)]) matching the query; everything for an empty query."""
    if not query.strip():
        return "all", list(glyphs)
    kind, test = matcher(query)
    return kind, [(name, codes) for name, codes in glyphs if test(name, codes)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- GUI
muted = names_muted


class Finder(names_dialog_type()):
    def __init__(self, parent: Any = None) -> None:
        """Build original controls; refresh once and retain only owned resources."""
        super().__init__(parent, TITLE, KEY)
        self.setMinimumWidth(480)
        self.resize(500, 560)
        self.glyphs = font_glyphs()
        self.matches = []
        root = self.root

        self.search = QtGui.QLineEdit()
        self.search.setPlaceholderText("acute · *.ss0? · é · U+00E9")
        self.search.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        big = self.search.font
        big.setPointSizeF(big.pointSizeF() * 1.15)
        self.search.setFont(big)
        root.addWidget(self.search)

        self.table = self.make_table(["Glyph", "Char", "Unicode"])
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(QtGui.QHeaderView.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(1, QtGui.QHeaderView.ResizeToContents)
        root.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        footer = QtGui.QHBoxLayout()
        self.status = QtGui.QLabel()
        self.status.setStyleSheet(f"color: {muted(self)};")
        footer.addWidget(self.status, 1)
        self.close_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Close")
        self.select_button = QtGui.QPushButton("Select in Font window")
        self.close_button.setAutoDefault(False)
        self.select_button.setDefault(True)
        footer.addWidget(self.close_button)
        footer.addWidget(self.select_button)
        root.addLayout(footer)

        self._connect(self.search.textChanged, lambda *a: self.refresh())
        self._connect(self.search.returnPressed, lambda *a: self.select_matches())
        self._connect(
            self.table.cellDoubleClicked,
            lambda row, *a: self.select_row(row),
        )
        self._connect(self.select_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.select_matches())
        self._connect(self.close_button.clicked, lambda *a: self.close())
        self.refresh()
        self.search.setFocus()

    @names_snapshot_refresh
    def refresh(self) -> None:
        """Read current font data; update original fields and action availability."""
        self.glyphs = font_glyphs()
        if not self.glyphs:
            self.subtitle.setText("Open a font first.")
            self.select_button.setEnabled(False)
            return
        kind, self.matches = find(self.glyphs, self.search.text)
        self.subtitle.setText(
            f"Searching {len(self.glyphs)} glyphs by {kind}. "
            "Enter selects every match in the Font window.",
        )
        shown = self.matches[:MAX_ROWS]
        accent = QtGui.QColor(self.palette.color(QtGui.QPalette.Link))
        self.table.setRowCount(len(shown))
        for row, (name, codes) in enumerate(shown):
            char = "".join(chr(c) for c in codes[:1])
            cells = [name, char, " ".join(f"U+{c:04X}" for c in codes) or "–"]
            for column, text in enumerate(cells):
                item = QtGui.QTableWidgetItem(text)
                if column == 1:
                    item.setTextAlignment(int(QtCore.Qt.AlignCenter))
                    item.setForeground(QtGui.QBrush(accent))
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        more = f" (showing {MAX_ROWS})" if len(self.matches) > MAX_ROWS else ""
        self.select_button.setEnabled(bool(self.matches))
        self.status.setText(
            f"{len(self.matches)} match{'es' if len(self.matches) != 1 else ''}{more}",
        )

    def select_matches(self) -> None:
        """Select chosen rows, or every match, in the scanned font only."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        rows = sorted(
            {index.row() for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()},
        )
        names = (
            [self.matches[r][0] for r in rows]
            if rows
            else [name for name, _ in self.matches]
        )
        count = len(self.select_names(names))
        self.last_result = {"selected": names}
        self.status.setText(
            f"Selected {count} glyph{'s' if count != 1 else ''} in the Font window",
        )

    def select_row(self, row: int) -> None:
        """Select one double-clicked result in the scanned font only."""
        self.ensure_snapshot()
        if 0 <= row < len(self.matches):
            count = len(self.select_names([self.matches[row][0]]))
            self.last_result = {"selected": [self.matches[row][0]]}
            self.status.setText(
                f"Selected {self.matches[row][0]}" if count else "Glyph not found",
            )


def main() -> Any:
    """Open or replace this owned modeless Names panel."""
    return show_script_dialog(Finder, KEY)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
